Phase: OIDC accounts Status: Complete — accepted Implementation snapshot: 2026-07-31 Starting commit: 16cf9c7

This is the accepted Phase 3 record. It documents the implemented identity and account boundary and the evidence used to close the phase. It does not claim that later library/comment/deletion behavior or the Production v0.0 definition of done is complete.

Scope and preserved invariants

  • Guest feed, paper, preparation, processing, Introduction, anonymous chat, Connections, arXiv links, and cached reading remain independent of account availability.
  • ACCOUNTS_ENABLED=false registers no /v1/me route and performs no OIDC discovery. Library, comments, blocks, reports, and deletion routes remain unpublished regardless of their later-phase flags.
  • Account-enabled required-auth routes fail closed when discovery, JWKS, token verification, or account storage is unavailable. That failure does not make the public reading service unready.
  • Authentication never changes the preparation boundary: startup, session restore, JIT provisioning, profile refresh, onboarding, and sign-out cannot submit a paper preparation request.
  • No password enters Pakperk. Tokens and OIDC subjects remain outside general preferences, Drift/SQLite, logs, analytics, crash reports, and public profile responses.

The exact setup, storage boundary, profile shapes, concurrency headers, error classes, and CORS contract are recorded in Account authentication and profile contract.

Backend identity boundary

The isolated auth crate provides:

  • bounded, redirect-free OIDC discovery and JWKS reads;
  • an explicit asymmetric algorithm allow-list;
  • exact issuer and audience checks plus required exp, iss, aud, and nonempty sub claims;
  • expiration/not-before validation with bounded clock skew;
  • signing-key lookup by kid, single-flight unknown-key refresh, a refresh cooldown, TTL-based refresh, and size/key-count bounds;
  • sanitized startup and verification failures that retain no token, claim, issuer, key ID, or upstream response body; and
  • a cloneable auth runtime that can atomically publish an available verifier after a background discovery retry without rebuilding the public router.

The Phase 3 identity-admin boundary is intentionally incomplete for destructive operations. NoopIdentityAdmin never reports false success, and the validated Keycloak adapter reports Unwired until Phase 6 supplies credential loading, provider calls, bounded retries, and deletion idempotency.

Local account and profile model

Migration 0004_accounts.sql introduces one local users row per exact (oidc_issuer, oidc_subject) identity. OIDC issuer and subject are private. The owner projection contains a server UUID, optional immutable handle, optional display name, status, monotonic profile version, terms acceptance, and timestamps.

JIT provisioning is transactional and safe under concurrent first requests. It does not copy provider email or profile fields and never reactivates a suspended/deletion-state account. last_seen_at updates at a bounded cadence instead of writing on every request.

Handles are canonical lowercase ASCII values containing only letters, digits, and underscore, 3–30 characters, with reserved/system names and URL/email shapes rejected. The database enforces defensive case-insensitive uniqueness. Display names are optional, NFKC-normalized, whitespace-collapsed, bounded to 80 Unicode scalar values, and reject control/directionality characters.

Profile writes use a strong "profile-N" validator and compare-and-swap versioning. Omitted and explicit-null display names remain distinct; handle is set-once and cannot be cleared; accepted terms must match the configured current version. A profile is complete only for an active account with a handle and current terms acceptance.

Shared rate-limit foundation

Migration 0005_shared_rate_limits.sql adds one bounded fixed-window row per (bucket, scope_key). Database statement time and atomic INSERT ... ON CONFLICT ... DO UPDATE make enforcement common to all API replicas. The first consumer is profile_update, keyed only by the verified Pakperk user UUID. A bounded skip-locked cleanup operation removes expired windows. Later phases add library, comments, reports, deletion, and eventual prepare/chat migration without another network service.

Authenticated profile API

When accounts are enabled, the server publishes:

GET   /v1/me
PATCH /v1/me

Both require the OpenAPI oidcBearer security scheme, JIT-map the verified identity, return Cache-Control: private, no-store, and return a strong ETag matching the profile version. PATCH requires exact If-Match, rejects unknown or empty input, and increments the profile version on success.

The stable error envelope covers authentication, account status, validation, handle conflict, precondition conflict, shared rate limiting, and temporary auth/storage availability. Challenges and retry timing are headers rather than token/provider details in response bodies. The checked OpenAPI artifact must be regenerated from the code-first contract and pass compatibility checks before this phase can be accepted.

Mobile session and profile behavior

The mobile auth layer is separated from Dio, Riverpod UI, and account APIs:

  • AppAuth opens the system browser for Authorization Code + PKCE and provider logout.
  • The access token lives only in memory. Platform secure storage holds the refresh token, optional ID-token logout hint, issuer/client binding, and optional non-secret local account UUID with a strict versioned codec.
  • Concurrent callers share one proactive or challenge-driven refresh. A 401 can replay once; write replay additionally requires a bounded If-Match or idempotency header.
  • Bearer credentials attach only to the exact configured Pakperk API origin. Public requests never wait for auth, and external origins never receive a token.
  • Epoch guards prevent late sign-in, refresh, account fetch, onboarding, or cleanup work from reviving an obsolete session.
  • invalid_grant produces guest state; ordinary provider/network errors preserve an offline/auth-unknown session.
  • Sign-out clears secure credentials and account-owned Drift rows while preserving public feed/paper cache and reader restoration.

The account client strictly parses the owner envelope and ETag, distinguishes omitted/null/value patches, and uses one current-account controller. The You branch keeps its guest state when the feature is off, launches real system authentication when enabled, JIT-loads /v1/me, requests handle/current terms onboarding for an incomplete account, shows the authenticated owner state, and supports sign-out. Pending authenticated actions hold at most one validated intent for later Save/comment phases.

Native and development-provider integration

  • Android declares the exact AppAuth redirect scheme, uses API level 23 or later for secure storage, disables backup, and supplies backup/data-extraction exclusions.
  • iOS registers the same callback scheme, uses a device-bound Keychain accessibility class, and disables the shared on-disk URL cache so an AppAuth response URL containing token material is not persisted.
  • The optional Compose accounts profile pins Keycloak 26.7.0 by digest, PostgreSQL 16.14, and Mailpit 1.30.6. Its imported development realm has a public native client, exact callback/logout URIs, PKCE S256, API audience, self-registration, email verification/recovery, brute-force protection, and rotating refresh tokens.

Checks and acceptance evidence

The settled Phase 3 tree passed the repository gate and the following focused acceptance runs on 2026-07-31:

The deterministic OpenAPI checker ran four compatibility tests. Focused mobile authentication tests passed 34/34, including concurrent refresh, one-time replay, invalid_grant, secure-store failure, restart, and bounded sign-out paths. The account/widget set passed 22/22 before the complete mobile run.

The real provider smoke used the pinned local Keycloak, its PostgreSQL store, and Mailpit. A disposable account self-registered, received and followed its verification email, completed Authorization Code + PKCE with the exact native callback and matching state, and exchanged the code for the configured openid profile audience. The API transactionally JIT-created the local user; GET /v1/me returned profile ETag "profile-1"; profile/terms onboarding returned "profile-2"; and a stale If-Match returned 412 PROFILE_VERSION_CONFLICT. Refresh-token rotation produced a working access token, a bogus refresh produced invalid_grant, and RP-initiated logout used the exact callback/state and invalidated the refresh session. No disposable credential or token was retained in the repository or this report.

Finally, Keycloak was stopped while the API remained running. /health/ready and an anonymous /v1/feed?limit=1 request both returned 200, proving that guest availability is independent of the identity provider.

Exit-criteria ledger

  • Guest reading works with OIDC offline/unavailable: accepted by the live provider-outage route check and required/optional-principal tests.
  • Test user can register, verify, and sign in: accepted by the real Keycloak/Mailpit/PKCE smoke flow.
  • Tokens are absent from general storage/logs: accepted by strict secure codec/schema inspection plus secret-redaction tests.
  • Expired access token refreshes once: accepted by single-flight and replay-once transport tests plus real refresh-token rotation.
  • Invalid refresh returns to guest without clearing public cache: accepted by invalid_grant, durable invalidation, restart, and scoped-cleanup tests.
  • Handle uniqueness and profile versioning work: accepted by live PostgreSQL and HTTP ETag/precondition scenarios.
  • Account feature can be disabled coherently: accepted by backend route absence, no-discovery, mobile feature-flag, and guest-shell tests.

Known risks and later-phase boundaries

  • Simulator builds and source/resource inspection do not replace final Keychain/Keystore, callback, backup/restore, and logout checks on signed physical-device release candidates.
  • OIDC startup retry must remain bounded and content-free under a long provider outage; required-auth failure must not alter public readiness.
  • Production-like identity deployments need their own HTTPS issuer, realm, native client, secret management, backups, and availability plan. The development realm is not a production configuration.
  • Keycloak admin session revocation and identity deletion are deliberately unwired until Phase 6; /v1/me deletion must remain absent in Phase 3.
  • Library actions, public comments, UGC controls, moderation, and deletion are not made complete by the account profile surface and remain independently gated in Phases 4–6.

阶段： OIDC 账户 状态： 已完成 — 已接受 实施快照： 2026-07-31 起始提交： 16cf9c7

这是已接受的第 3 阶段记录。它记录了已实现的身份与账户边界以及用于收口该阶段的证据。它不声称后续的论文库/评论/删除行为或 Production v0.0 完成定义已完成。

范围与保留的不变量

  • 访客 Feed、论文、准备、处理、Introduction、匿名聊天、Connections、arXiv 链接和缓存阅读保持独立于账户可用性。
  • ACCOUNTS_ENABLED=false 不注册任何 /v1/me 路由，也不执行 OIDC 发现。Library、评论、屏蔽、举报和删除路由保持不发布，无论其后续阶段的开关如何。
  • 启用账户后的必需认证路由在发现、JWKS、令牌验证或账户存储不可用时会失败即拒绝。该失败不会让公开阅读服务变为未就绪。
  • 认证绝不会改变准备边界：启动、会话恢复、JIT 即时预配、资料刷新、引导和退出登录都不能提交论文准备请求。
  • 任何密码都不会进入 Pakperk。令牌和 OIDC 主体标识始终位于常规偏好设置、Drift/SQLite、日志、分析、崩溃报告和公开资料响应之外。

精确的设置、存储边界、资料形态、并发标头、错误类别和 CORS 技术契约记录在账户认证与用户资料技术契约中。

后端身份边界

独立的 auth crate 提供：

  • 有界、无重定向的 OIDC 发现和 JWKS 读取；
  • 显式的非对称算法允许列表；
  • 精确的签发方和受众检查，加上必需的 exp、iss、aud 和非空 sub 声明；
  • 带有界时钟偏移的过期/not-before（生效时间下限）验证；
  • 按 kid 查找签名密钥、合并并发的未知密钥刷新、刷新冷却、基于 TTL 的刷新，以及大小/密钥数边界；
  • 脱敏的启动和验证失败，不保留任何令牌、声明、签发方、密钥 ID 或上游响应正文；以及
  • 一个可克隆的认证运行时，它能在后台发现重试后原子地发布可用验证器，而无需重建公开路由器。

第 3 阶段的身份管理边界对破坏性操作有意不完整。NoopIdentityAdmin 绝不报告虚假成功，且经过验证的 Keycloak 适配器会报告 Unwired，直到 Phase 6 提供凭据加载、提供商调用、有界重试和删除幂等性。

本地账户与资料模型

迁移 0004_accounts.sql 引入本地 users 行，每个精确的 (oidc_issuer, oidc_subject) 身份对应一行。OIDC 签发方和主体标识是私有的。所有者投影包含服务器 UUID、可选的不可变用户名、可选显示名、状态、单调资料版本、条款接受和时间戳。

JIT 即时预配是事务性的，并且在并发首次请求下是安全的。它不复制提供商电子邮件或资料字段，也绝不重新激活被封禁/删除状态的账户。last_seen_at 以有界的节奏更新，而不是在每个请求时写入。

用户名是规范的 ASCII 小写值，只包含字母、数字和下划线，长度为 3–30 个字符，保留/系统名称以及 URL/电子邮件形状会被拒绝。数据库强制执行防御性的不区分大小写唯一性。显示名是可选的，经 NFKC 规范化、空白折叠，限制在 80 个 Unicode 标量值内，并拒绝控制/方向性字符。

资料写入使用强 "profile-N" 验证器和比较并交换版本控制。省略与显式 null 的显示名保持不同；用户名只能设置一次且不能清除；已接受的条款必须匹配配置的当前版本。只有拥有用户名和当前条款接受的活跃账户，其资料才算完整。

共享限流基础

迁移 0005_shared_rate_limits.sql 为每个 (bucket, scope_key) 新增一行有界的固定窗口记录。数据库语句执行时间和原子的 INSERT ... ON CONFLICT ... DO UPDATE 使强制执行对所有 API 副本通用。第一个使用方是 profile_update，仅由已验证的 Pakperk 用户 UUID 作键。有界的跳过锁定清理操作会移除过期窗口。后续阶段会添加论文库、评论、举报、删除以及最终的准备/聊天迁移，而无需另一个网络服务。

已认证资料 API

启用账户后，服务器会发布：

GET   /v1/me
PATCH /v1/me

两者都要求 OpenAPI oidcBearer 安全方案，对已验证身份进行 JIT 映射，返回 Cache-Control: private, no-store，并返回与资料版本匹配的强 ETag。PATCH 要求精确的 If-Match，拒绝未知或空输入，并在成功时递增资料版本。

稳定的错误封装覆盖认证、账户状态、验证、用户名冲突、前置条件冲突、共享限流以及临时的认证/存储不可用。质询和重试时机通过标头传递，而不是响应正文中的令牌/提供商详情。已检入的 OpenAPI 产物必须从代码优先的技术契约重新生成并通过兼容性检查，然后本阶段才能被接受。

移动端会话与资料行为

移动端认证层与 Dio、Riverpod UI 和账户 API 分离：

  • AppAuth 会打开系统浏览器执行 Authorization Code + PKCE 和提供商注销。
  • 访问令牌只存在于内存中。平台安全存储持有刷新令牌、可选的 ID 令牌注销提示、签发方/客户端绑定，以及带严格版本化编解码器的可选非密钥本地账户 UUID。
  • 并发调用方共享一个主动的或质询驱动的刷新。401 可以重放一次；写重放还额外要求有界的 If-Match 或幂等标头。
  • Bearer 凭据只附加到精确配置的 Pakperk API 源。公开请求绝不等待认证，外部源也绝不会收到令牌。
  • 纪元防护会阻止迟到的登录、刷新、账户获取、引导或清理工作复活过期的会话。
  • invalid_grant 会产生访客状态；普通的提供商/网络错误会保留离线/认证未知会话。
  • 退出登录会清除安全凭据和归账户所有的 Drift 行，同时保留公开 Feed/论文缓存和阅读器恢复状态。

账户客户端严格解析所有者封装和 ETag，区分省略/null/有值补丁，并使用一个当前账户控制器。You 分支在功能关闭时保持其访客状态，在启用时启动真实的系统认证，JIT 加载 /v1/me，为不完整账户请求用户名/当前条款引导，显示已认证的所有者状态，并支持退出登录。待处理的已认证操作最多持有一个经过验证的意图，供后续的收藏/评论阶段使用。

原生与开发提供商集成

  • Android 声明精确的 AppAuth 重定向方案，使用 API level 23 或更高版本以实现安全存储，禁用备份，并提供备份/数据提取排除项。
  • iOS 注册相同的回调方案，使用设备绑定的 Keychain 数据保护类别，并禁用共享的磁盘 URL 缓存，这样包含令牌材料的 AppAuth 响应 URL 就不会被持久化。
  • 可选的 Compose accounts profile 通过摘要固定 Keycloak 26.7.0、PostgreSQL 16.14 和 Mailpit 1.30.6。其导入的开发 Realm 拥有原生公共客户端、精确的回调/注销 URI、PKCE S256、API 受众、自助注册、电子邮件验证/恢复、暴力破解防护和轮换的刷新令牌。

检查与验收证据

已定稿的 Phase 3 代码树于 2026-07-31 通过了仓库门禁和以下聚焦验收运行：

确定性的 OpenAPI 检查器运行了四项兼容性测试。聚焦的移动端认证测试通过 34/34，包括并发刷新、一次性重放、invalid_grant、安全存储失败、重启和有界退出登录路径。账户/组件测试集在完整移动端运行之前通过 22/22。

真实提供商冒烟测试使用了固定的本地 Keycloak、其 PostgreSQL 存储和 Mailpit。一个一次性账户完成自助注册、接收并点击验证电子邮件、以精确的原生回调和匹配的 state 完成 Authorization Code + PKCE，并将代码兑换为配置的 openid profile 受众。API 以事务方式 JIT 创建本地用户；GET /v1/me 返回资料 ETag "profile-1"；资料/条款引导返回 "profile-2"；过期的 If-Match 返回 412 PROFILE_VERSION_CONFLICT。刷新令牌轮换产生了可用的访问令牌，伪造的刷新产生 invalid_grant，RP 发起的注销使用精确的回调/state 并使刷新会话失效。仓库和本报告中没有保留任何一次性凭据或令牌。

最后，在 API 保持运行的同时停止了 Keycloak。/health/ready 和匿名 /v1/feed?limit=1 请求都返回 200，证明访客可用性独立于身份提供商。

退出标准台账

  • **OIDC 离线/不可用时访客阅读仍可工作：**由真实的提供商中断路由检查以及必需/可选主体测试验收。
  • **测试用户可以注册、验证并登录：**由真实的 Keycloak/Mailpit/PKCE 冒烟流程验收。
  • **令牌不出现在常规存储/日志中：**由严格的 codec/schema 安全检查加上密钥脱敏测试验收。
  • **过期的访问令牌只刷新一次：**由合并并发和单次重放传输测试以及真实的刷新令牌轮换验收。
  • **无效刷新返回访客状态而不清除公开缓存：**由 invalid_grant、持久失效、重启和限定范围清理测试验收。
  • **用户名唯一性和资料版本控制正常工作：**由真实 PostgreSQL 和 HTTP ETag/前置条件场景验收。
  • **账户功能可以连贯地禁用：**由后端路由缺席、无发现、移动端功能开关和访客壳层测试验收。

已知风险与后续阶段边界

  • 模拟器构建和源代码/资源检查不能替代在签名的真机发布候选版本上进行的最终 Keychain/Keystore、回调、备份/恢复和注销检查。
  • 在长时间提供商中断期间，OIDC 启动重试必须保持有界且不含内容；必需认证的失败不得改变公开就绪状态。
  • 类生产的身份部署需要自己的 HTTPS 签发方、Realm、原生客户端、密钥管理、备份和可用性计划。开发 Realm 不是生产配置。
  • Keycloak 管理会话撤销和身份删除在 Phase 6 之前有意保持未接线；/v1/me 删除必须在第 3 阶段保持缺席。
  • Library 操作、公开评论、UGC 控件、内容审核和删除不会因账户资料界面而变为已完成，并在阶段 4–6 中保持独立门禁。
